name: go-validation-ufo-util
description: GO validation of the shipped product on a fresh recurring family (unjs/ufo: add a URL utility). Training = the user's history with the product installed and learning by itself; held out = control (hooks, directives withheld) vs adage (the full product). See prereg.json.

task_prompts.ufo-util--without-query:
Add a new utility to ufo: `withoutQuery(input)`, which removes the query section from a URL and keeps everything else, the fragment included.

```js
withoutQuery("/foo?bar=1#baz"); // "/foo#baz"
withoutQuery("http://example.com/path?a=1&b=2"); // "http://example.com/path"
withoutQuery("/foo"); // "/foo"
```

It must be exported from the package like the other utilities. Include tests, and document it in the README, as the project does for its other utilities.
task_prompts.ufo-util--with-port:
Add a new utility to ufo: `withPort(input, port)`, which sets or replaces the port of an absolute URL. A URL without a host is returned unchanged.

```js
withPort("http://example.com/foo", 8080); // "http://example.com:8080/foo"
withPort("https://example.com:3000/", 443); // "https://example.com:443/"
withPort("/foo", 8080); // "/foo"
```

It must be exported from the package like the other utilities. Include tests, and document it in the README, as the project does for its other utilities.
task_prompts.ufo-util--get-origin:
Add a new utility to ufo: `getOrigin(input)`, which returns the origin of an absolute URL (its protocol and host, with the port if there is one, without credentials), or an empty string for a URL without a host.

```js
getOrigin("https://example.com:8080/foo?x=1"); // "https://example.com:8080"
getOrigin("http://user:pass@example.com/x"); // "http://example.com"
getOrigin("/foo"); // ""
```

It must be exported from the package like the other utilities. Include tests, and document it in the README, as the project does for its other utilities.
task_prompts.ufo-util--path-segments:
Add a new utility to ufo: `getPathSegments(input)`, which returns the non-empty segments of a URL's path as an array of decoded strings (the query and the fragment are ignored).

```js
getPathSegments("/foo/bar%20baz/"); // ["foo", "bar baz"]
getPathSegments("http://example.com/a/b?c=1#d"); // ["a", "b"]
getPathSegments("/"); // []
```

It must be exported from the package like the other utilities. Include tests, and document it in the README, as the project does for its other utilities.
task_prompts.ufo-util--without-auth:
Add a new utility to ufo: `withoutAuth(input)`, which removes the credentials (`user:password@`) from a URL and keeps everything else.

```js
withoutAuth("https://user:pass@example.com/foo?x=1"); // "https://example.com/foo?x=1"
withoutAuth("http://admin@example.com"); // "http://example.com"
withoutAuth("https://example.com/foo"); // "https://example.com/foo"
```

It must be exported from the package like the other utilities. Include tests, and document it in the README, as the project does for its other utilities.
task_prompts.ufo-util--same-origin:
Add a new utility to ufo: `isSameOrigin(a, b)`, which checks whether two absolute URLs have the same origin: the same protocol and the same host, port included, compared case-insensitively. URLs without a host never have the same origin.

```js
isSameOrigin("https://example.com/a", "https://EXAMPLE.com/b?x=1"); // true
isSameOrigin("http://example.com", "https://example.com"); // false
isSameOrigin("https://example.com:8080/", "https://example.com/"); // false
isSameOrigin("/a", "/b"); // false
```

It must be exported from the package like the other utilities. Include tests, and document it in the README, as the project does for its other utilities.
task_prompts.ufo-util--sort-query:
Add a new utility to ufo: `sortQuery(input)`, which sorts the query parameters of a URL by key, alphabetically, and keeps the path and the fragment.

```js
sortQuery("/foo?b=2&a=1&c=3#top"); // "/foo?a=1&b=2&c=3#top"
sortQuery("http://example.com/?z=1&y=2"); // "http://example.com/?y=2&z=1"
sortQuery("/foo"); // "/foo"
```

It must be exported from the package like the other utilities. Include tests, and document it in the README, as the project does for its other utilities.
task_prompts.ufo-util--lowercase-host:
Add a new utility to ufo: `withLowercaseHost(input)`, which lower-cases the protocol and the host of a URL and leaves the path, the query and the fragment as they are.

```js
withLowercaseHost("HTTPS://Example.COM/Foo?Q=1#Top"); // "https://example.com/Foo?Q=1#Top"
withLowercaseHost("http://WWW.Example.org"); // "http://www.example.org"
withLowercaseHost("/Foo/Bar"); // "/Foo/Bar"
```

It must be exported from the package like the other utilities. Include tests, and document it in the README, as the project does for its other utilities.
task_prompts.ufo-util--get-extension:
Add a new utility to ufo: `getExtension(input)`, which returns the file extension of the last segment of a URL's path, lower-cased and without the dot, or `undefined` when it has none (the query and the fragment are ignored).

```js
getExtension("/files/report.PDF?download=1"); // "pdf"
getExtension("http://example.com/archive.tar.gz"); // "gz"
getExtension("/files/README"); // undefined
getExtension("/folder/"); // undefined
```

It must be exported from the package like the other utilities. Include tests, and document it in the README, as the project does for its other utilities.
task_prompts.ufo-util--dot-segments:
Add a new utility to ufo: `withoutDotSegments(input)`, which resolves the `.` and `..` segments of a URL's path (as a browser does) and keeps the protocol, the host, the query and the fragment.

```js
withoutDotSegments("/a/./b/../c"); // "/a/c"
withoutDotSegments("http://example.com/a/b/../../c?x=1"); // "http://example.com/c?x=1"
withoutDotSegments("/a/.."); // "/"
withoutDotSegments("/a/b/"); // "/a/b/"
```

It must be exported from the package like the other utilities. Include tests, and document it in the README, as the project does for its other utilities.
task_prompts.ufo-util--query-param:
Add a new utility to ufo: `getQueryParam(input, key)`, which returns the decoded value of one query parameter of a URL: the first value when the key is repeated, or `undefined` when the key is absent.

```js
getQueryParam("/foo?a=1&b=2", "b"); // "2"
getQueryParam("/foo?a=1&a=2", "a"); // "1"
getQueryParam("/foo?q=hello+world", "q"); // "hello world"
getQueryParam("/foo", "a"); // undefined
```

It must be exported from the package like the other utilities. Include tests, and document it in the README, as the project does for its other utilities.
task_prompts.ufo-util--is-http:
Add a new utility to ufo: `isHttpURL(input)`, which checks whether the input is an absolute `http:` or `https:` URL (the protocol is compared case-insensitively; protocol-relative and relative URLs are not).

```js
isHttpURL("https://example.com"); // true
isHttpURL("HTTP://example.com/x"); // true
isHttpURL("ftp://example.com"); // false
isHttpURL("//example.com"); // false
isHttpURL("/foo"); // false
```

It must be exported from the package like the other utilities. Include tests, and document it in the README, as the project does for its other utilities.
